label: Buy volume
gloss: the bar's buy-side traded volume, in base-asset units

label: Sell volume
gloss: the bar's sell-side traded volume, in base-asset units

label: Quote volume
gloss: the bar's traded notional, in USD: the sum of each trade's price × size from the live tape; absent for a bar holding a minute the live tape did not cover, never zero

label: Buy quote volume
gloss: the bar's buy-side traded notional, in USD: the sum of each taker buy's price × size from the live tape; absent for a bar holding a minute the live tape did not cover, never zero

label: Sell quote volume
gloss: the bar's sell-side traded notional, in USD: the sum of each taker sell's price × size from the live tape; absent for a bar holding a minute the live tape did not cover, never zero

label: Notional volume (24h)
gloss: 24-hour traded notional volume, USD

label: RVOL (relative volume)

gloss: relative volume — the bar’s volume divided by its 20-period average, as a multiple (1.0 = at baseline, 2.0 = twice baseline)

label: OBV (offset arbitrary)
gloss: on-balance volume — the running sum of sign(Δclose) × volume from the first bar this column reads, in base-asset units; its level is arbitrary, so read its change, slope or trend, which agree with TradingView’s OBV

label: CMF (20)
gloss: 20-period Chaikin money flow — each bar's volume weighted by where it closed in its range (−1 at the low, +1 at the high, 0 on a flat bar), summed over the 20 bars ending at this bar and divided by their volume; no value when that volume is zero

period.description: The indicator’s length: the bars its window reads.

label: Order-flow CVD (UTC day)
gloss: order-flow cumulative volume delta — taker buy minus taker sell volume from the trade tape, accumulated since the daily 00:00-UTC anchor

label: Cumulative Volume Delta (UTC day)
gloss: TradingView's cumulative volume delta — each intrabar's volume signed by its close against its open, then against the previous intrabar's close, summed since the daily 00:00-UTC anchor; intrabars are 1m on minute and hour rungs and 5m on 1d

label: Order-flow spot CVD (composite, UTC day)
gloss: order-flow composite centralized-exchange spot cumulative volume delta at each bar, the listed venues that publish their trade history (Binance, Coinbase) summed through the bar's last minute since the daily 00:00-UTC anchor, in this coin's own unit (crypto coins the spot lane lists)

label: Buy pressure
gloss: buy share of traded volume (0–1)

label: Buy pressure (Coinbase)
gloss: buy share of Coinbase's spot volume in the bar's period (0–1), from the venue's taker sides

label: Buy pressure (Binance)
gloss: buy share of Binance's spot volume in the bar's period (0–1), from the venue's taker sides

label: Spot avg trade
gloss: the composite spot volume per trade in the bar's period, over the listed venues that publish their trade history (Binance, Coinbase), in this coin's own unit; absent where one of those venues did not cover the period or nothing traded

label: Spot dominance
gloss: the composite spot volume, over the listed venues that publish their trade history (Binance, Coinbase), as a share of composite spot plus the bar's perp volume, both in this coin's own unit (0–1); absent where one of those venues did not cover the period

label: Buy trades
gloss: the bar's buy trade count

label: Sell trades
gloss: the bar's sell trade count

label: Funding rate
gloss: the perpetual funding rate (%), a point-in-time read at its own sample time

label: Funding annualized
gloss: the funding rate annualized (%), a point-in-time read at its own sample time

label: Funding label
gloss: the funding-pressure band over a point-in-time rate read at its own sample time

label: Open interest
gloss: open interest, USD notional — a point-in-time read at its own sample time

label: OI change
gloss: open interest against the mean of its own 24 hourly samples (%), each a point-in-time read at its own sample time

label: OI velocity
gloss: the pace of open-interest change across point-in-time samples, each read at its own sample time

label: OI · price regime
gloss: open interest's direction over its newest samples read against the 1h change, ((frame price − 1h bar open) / 1h bar open) × 100 — read live, so it moves until that bar closes

label: Regime · trend
gloss: the platform-classified trend regime

label: Regime · volatility
gloss: the platform-classified volatility regime

label: Regime · momentum
gloss: the platform-classified momentum regime

label: Regime · state
gloss: the market structure the platform classified — trend or range, up or down — at the confirmed close; its volatility and warnings are read beside it
